meta.title: 掌握这3句口诀，跟任何人出门都能出片
meta.title_en: Master These 3 Mantras and Every Outing Shoots Well
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 三句口诀

scenes.title_cn: 方法：教人一遍就会的口诀
scenes.title_en: The Method: Mantras Anyone Gets in One Try
scenes.context: 给大家看我老公之前跟我旅行拍的照片，再看他这次出门给我拍的照片，是不是有进步？以前不拍照、对相机陌生的助理也出了网图。我有几个无比简单的培训口诀，教人一遍就会。语域：博主分享，成果引入。
sentences: 给大家看一下我老公之前给我拍的照片。
Let me show you the photos my husband took of me before.
photos my husband took（老公拍的照片）
是不是感觉有进步？
Can you feel the improvement?
feel the improvement（感觉有进步）
我有几个无比简单的培训口诀，教人一遍就会。
I have dead-simple training mantras that anyone gets in one try.
training mantras（培训口诀）
paraphrase: 有进步 → feel the improvement / see the progress
一遍就会 → gets it in one try / clicks instantly
scenes.speak: Let me show you the photos my husband took of me before. Can you feel the improvement? I have dead-simple training mantras that anyone gets in one try.

scenes.context: 三句口诀：一光二景三人。口诀1光：你迎着光，他背着光；顶光找阴阳交界，站阴面。口诀2景：景乱人大、景美人让景，除你外不超3元素。语域：拍照教学，口诀输出。
sentences: 三句口诀：一光二景三人。
Three mantras: light, scene, people.
three mantras（三句口诀）
口诀1·光：你迎着光，他背着光。
Mantra one·light: you face the light, he stands against it.
face the light（迎着光）
口诀2·景：景乱人大、景美人让景。
Mantra two·scene: messy scene makes the person big; pretty scene makes the person yield.
makes the person yield（人让景）
paraphrase: 迎着光 → face the light / stand toward the light
人让景 → person yields / let the scene shine
scenes.speak: Three mantras: light, scene, people. Mantra one·light: you face the light, he stands against it. Mantra two·scene: messy scene makes the person big; pretty scene makes the person yield.

scenes.context: 口诀3人：人放两条竖线上和竖线平行，十有八九能用。进阶：人放四个交汇点（脑袋一点+腿一点）；自拍让出中间格。语域：拍照教学，口诀+进阶。
sentences: 口诀3·人：人放两条竖线上，和竖线平行。
Mantra three·person: place the person on one of two vertical lines.
vertical lines（竖线）
十有八九能用。
Nine times out of ten, it works.
nine times out of ten（十有八九）
进阶：人放四个交汇点。
Advanced: place the person at the four intersection points.
intersection points（交汇点）
paraphrase: 竖线 → vertical lines / rule-of-thirds lines
交汇点 → intersection points / power points
scenes.speak: Mantra three·person: place the person on one of two vertical lines. Nine times out of ten, it works. Advanced: place the person at the four intersection points.

scenes.title_en: Muscle Memory: Slight Tilt on the Phone
scenes.context: 肌肉记忆：抬手机微微扣一点，呈正三角；前置+他人按快门拍刁钻角度。把这几个要点变成习惯，随便拍都出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 肌肉记忆：抬手机微微扣一点。
Muscle memory: lift the phone with a slight inward tilt.
a slight inward tilt（微微内扣）
呈正三角，画面更稳。
Form an upward triangle for a steadier frame.
an upward triangle（正三角）
把要点变成习惯，随便拍都出片。
Turn the keys into habits, and every shot works.
every shot works（随便拍都出片）
paraphrase: 肌肉记忆 → muscle memory / automatic habit
正三角 → upward triangle / triangular grip
scenes.speak: Muscle memory: lift the phone with a slight inward tilt. Form an upward triangle for a steadier frame. Turn the keys into habits, and every shot works.

practice: Can you feel the improvement in the photos?
Face the light; messy scene makes the person big.
Place the person on one of two vertical lines — nine times out of ten it works.
Lift the phone with a slight inward tilt and form an upward triangle.
pitfalls: The photos my husband took of me.
「拍的照片」用 photos my husband took，take 的过去分词是 taken。
You face light and he back light.
You face the light, he stands against it.
Messy scene makes the person big.
「景乱人大」用 messy scene makes the person big。
Lift the phone with a slight inward tilt.
「微微内扣」用 a slight inward tilt。
shifts: 用 mantras（口诀）、face the light（迎光）、vertical lines（竖线）
用 intersection points（交汇点）、upward triangle（正三角）、rule-of-thirds（三分法）
用 feel the improvement（有进步）、clicks instantly（一遍就会）、every shot works（随便拍都出片）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：乘门→出门、培训力心→培训口诀、皮→拍、很好皮→很好拍、正三角、竖线、交汇点、阴阳交界、顶光、景乱人大、让出中间格等。
